decisions.statement: A body is worked out by replaying the answer rather than read off the answer.
The answer is replayed onto the commit at HEAD rather than onto the tree.
A path that commit holds nothing at is read off the tree.
An add is refused there.
An edit that will not replay refuses.
Nothing is merged onto anything.
A refusal names each path a rename moved after the change was drafted.
A path renamed twice is named by the path the last rename left that body at.
A body is formatted before that body is handed on.
Every body a landing takes is formatted in one run rather than one at a time.
Which paths the formatter has already left are handed on beside the rows.
A path the answer carries away is handed on as no body.
A move no other edit names is handed on as a path moved rather than as a body.
A bring no other edit names is handed on as that bring rather than as a body.
The path a bring names is read for no body and formatted by nothing.
Neither path of a move is read for a body or handed on as one.
A path an edit names carries whether its readers owe the reading again.
A move has that owing at both the path it left and the path it reached.
An edit saying nothing of its readers has no owing for that path.
Nothing here writes the tree.

definition: the bodies a landing takes, worked out from the answer a change gave
